tasks.title: Spike: subagent child promptability and ID visibility
tasks.notes: Q1 YES (prompted finished explore child, replied OK under its agent config). Q2 NO (parent model never sees child ID). Title==description confirmed. Evidence in task notes.

tasks.title: Mapping schema: task and parent fields
tasks.notes: `go vet` clean; full `go test ./...` green. Old-shaped files load without empty keys; new fields round-trip; listByTask verified; client parses parentID.

tasks.title: Board UI: per-task sub list with talk button
tasks.notes: `go vet` + full suite green; binary rebuilt. Live (scratch repo, port 9099): board HTML serves #board-subs, task-sessions bind 201, sessions payload carries task/parent, served app.js has the chip renderer. Browser-visual check awaits the user's 9090 server restart.

tasks.title: changePrompt delegation and bind instructions
tasks.notes: `go vet` clean; full suite green; prompt pins extended (Delegation is optional, description prefix, title verbatim). The new prime reaches only sessions created after the 9090 server restart (user step).

tasks.title: Bind endpoint for task sessions
tasks.notes: `go vet` clean; full suite green. Guard matrix tested: 201 happy (Parent from live session), 200 idempotent retry, 409 rebind/wrong-change caller/taken sub, 422 unknown task + dead sub, 404 unknown change, 503 no service.

tasks.title: parentID reconciler on session list
tasks.notes: `go vet` clean; full suite green. Children of bound sessions map on list serve: task from title prefix (unknown/absent prefixes map taskless), deduped across serves, foreign parents ignored, service failure fail-open.
